svg.title: FoundryIQ: knowledge ingestion and retrieval
svg.desc: 1 Source Markdown documents are uploaded with authentication to 2 Azure Blob Storage. 3 An Azure AI Search indexer extracts the content into 4 a text index with semantic ranking. 5 The searchIndex knowledge source references the index. 6 The knowledge base references the source for retrieval and synthesis. 7 The KB MCP endpoint exposes knowledge tools using 2026-05-01-preview. 8 A RemoteTool Foundry connection with ProjectManagedIdentity lets the Toolbox call the endpoint and return grounded agent results. Bicep creates the connection and RBAC; postprovision configures the ingestion and knowledge resources.

g.text: Numbered stages show the content and retrieval path, not provisioning order
